question: What is a family secret you found out completely by accident?
story: I found out at fifteen that my family had been celebrating my birthday on the wrong day my entire life. I was digging through a drawer looking for a permission slip and found my actual birth certificate. April ninth. We had been throwing parties on June second. Not close. Not a typo. Two completely different months. So I brought it to my mom, and she did not even look up from the sink. She said, yes, we know. Apparently my grandmother had booked a hall for June second before I was even born, and when I showed up seven weeks early, she flatly refused to move the date. Everyone just went along with it. For fifteen years. Here is the part that gets me. June second is summer. April ninth is a school day. My grandmother accidentally gave me a lifetime of pool parties. I have never corrected a single person.
